description: Lane input keys for result reuse (design B): a hash of every file a CI lane reads (Nx task input patterns, caller-graph files, selectors) in one commit's tree, computed from git ls-tree so a consumer can recompute a producer's key. The test checks each lane's key covers every file Nx hashes for its tasks. lane_key_replay.mjs estimates per-lane reuse over history; nothing in CI uses keys yet.
